title: The Knights of Ren Arrive
description: Up on an overlook, it is clear that the First Order is now present in full-force as the six members of the Knights of Ren assemble, weapons drawn, to hunt for Rey. The Resistance has made it to Ochi's ship, but a tremor in the Force tells Rey that Kylo Ren is approaching, and she departs the ship to confront him.
